title: Check a digital trade licence or credential in the Service NSW app
summary: Learn how to check the details and live features of a digital trade licence or credential using the Service NSW app.
what_you_need: Service NSW app on a mobile device

how_to_steps.text: Check details as you would with a physical card including:

internal_links.text: add a digital version of a licence or credential

faqs.q: How do I check my digital trade licence or credential?
faqs.a: You can check the details and live features of your digital trade licence or credential as you would with a physical card, including checking the date and time by asking the worker to swipe down the digital licence or credential to refresh the screen.

faqs.q: What should I do if I have trouble using the licence scanner?
faqs.a: To improve the scan, try increasing the screen brightness, holding the phone steady, cleaning the screen, or moving the screen out of direct sunlight.
